name: Trade Shortcuts
tagline: Set the rule. Tap the trade.
description: Trade Shortcuts on your G2: rules you build on the phone (one scope, conditions joined by and/or, one action) watch your positions and raise exact proposals on the lens. Every trade needs your tap on the glasses. Bybit demo/testnet only.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks to your own Trade Shortcuts server, which holds the exchange keys.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Voice shortcuts. Listens only after you tap, for up to 5 seconds. The audio goes to your Trade Shortcuts server, which sends it to OpenAI for transcription.
